R607.note: Removes the double-decode, rejects traversal/separator chars, and verifies containment via canonical Path.startsWith; the single-filename restriction is the core CWE-22 fix itself, not an unrelated new restriction.

R608.note: Adds Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax to the cookie; stated hardening that blocks no legitimate login flow.

R609.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterizes both tenantId and the %term% pattern, preserving the contains-search and tenant-scoping contract exactly, including empty-term behavior.

R610.note: store.New() is a no-op fix: gorilla/sessions' Get() internally calls New() and both decode any existing cookie into session.Values and set IsNew=false identically when a cookie is present (confirmed against gorilla/sessions source), so the attacker-planted session is not discarded; behavior is otherwise unchanged so nothing new is broken.

R611.note: The EscapeLogValue switch contains 'case \'\':' which is invalid C# (unterminated char literal) and fails to compile (confirmed via dotnet build: CS1010/CS1012/CS1003); even ignoring that, most cases append the identical character back (C# string literals like "\n" already produce the raw control char), so the escaping is a no-op besides being unbuildable, and the write-up does not disclose either problem.

R612.note: Jwts.parser() in jjwt 0.11.5 (the version pinned in the file's own pom.xml comment) returns JwtParser, which has parseClaimsJws but no parseSignedClaims method - confirmed by compiling against the real 0.11.5 jars (javac: cannot find symbol parseSignedClaims); parseSignedClaims is 0.12.x API, so the fix does not compile, undisclosed.

R613.note: eval() is fully removed and replaced by a self-contained tokenizer/recursive-descent parser restricted to digits/operators/parens, closing the injection cleanly; but it silently changes output type (always returns float, e.g. 4.0 instead of int 4 for whole-number results) and silently drops support for unary/leading minus (e.g. "-5+3"), a plausible legitimate input the original eval() handled, neither disclosed.

R614.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare enforces exact-length, exact-byte equality per the stated contract and adds disclosed timing-safety hardening with no legitimate-use impact.

R615.note: self.get_object() applies get_queryset()'s owner filter plus check_object_permissions(IsInvoiceOwner), giving Http404 for both missing and other-users' invoices and full access for staff, matching the stated contract exactly.

R616.note: CGI::escapeHTML applied to both interpolated values before output; no other observable change.

R617.note: Adds a resource-level ownership check (GetMessageAsync + AuthorUserId comparison, HubException on mismatch) consistent with the existing SendMessage identity pattern; only blocks the previously-unauthorized delete path.

R618.note: Removes the is_staff bypass so get_queryset() always scopes to the owner, matching the case's own docstring that IsTicketOwner is meant to be the sole access rule.
